signIn.title: Sign in to garret
signIn.lede: Use the account your administrator invited you with.
signIn.failed: The username or password is not correct.
error.network: The server cannot be reached. Check that you are on the same network.
projects.title: Projects
projects.empty: No projects yet. An administrator creates the first one.
projects.loadFailed: The projects could not be loaded.
notFound.title: Page not found
thread.label: Thread by {author}
composer.placeholder: Write a comment. Markdown is supported.
composer.failed: The comment was not saved. Try again.
conversation.empty: No comments on the review as a whole yet.
files.none: No files changed in this revision.
files.basesDiffer: The revisions have different bases; the diff includes changes from the target branch.
files.tooLarge: This file is too large to show here.
revisions.title: Revision {number}
revisions.omitted: More commits than can be listed.
review.loadFailed: The review could not be loaded.
review.actionFailed: That did not work. Reload and try again.
collab.placeholder: Describe the fix, how to verify it and what is still open.
collab.failed: The description could not be opened.
project.title: Title
project.openFailed: The review could not be opened. A branch may already have an open review, or have no commits beyond the target.
project.createFailed: The discussion could not be started.
discussion.loadFailed: The discussion could not be loaded.
inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.kind.revision_on_reviewed: New revision on a review you took part in
app.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
error.notFound: It no longer exists. Reload the page.
error.conflict: Someone changed this at the same time. Reload and try again.
error.exportRequired: Export the project before you purge it.
account.title: Account
account.tokensLede: Git asks for a password when you push or fetch over HTTPS. Use an access token as that password.
account.tokenNameHint: Where you use it, such as the laptop's name.
account.tokenCreated: Token “{name}” is ready. Copy it now: it is not shown again.
account.tokenRevokePrompt: Revoke “{name}”? Git stops accepting it at once.
account.certificatesLede: Each device holds its own client certificate. The browser presents it before the sign-in page loads.
account.certRevokePrompt: Revoke the certificate of {name}? That device can no longer reach garret.
account.certRevokeCurrent: This is the certificate this browser uses. Revoke it and this device is locked out until you enroll it again.
admin.title: Administration
admin.forbidden: Only administrators can open this page.
admin.projectsLede: Export a project to one archive once the fix is public, then purge it from this server.
admin.projectNameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. It becomes part of the clone URL.
admin.exportIncomplete: The export stopped before it finished, so nothing was saved. Try again.
admin.purgeWarning: Purging deletes {name}, its repository and its whole review history from this server. It cannot be undone.
admin.invitationsLede: An invitation is a link and a code. Give them to the new member through two different channels, such as a chat message and in person.
admin.invited: The invitation is ready. The code is shown only now.
admin.inviteRevokePrompt: Revoke this invitation? Its code stops working.
admin.usersLede: Disabling a user ends their sessions and revokes their tokens and certificates. Their comments stay.
admin.eraseLede: Erasure removes content for good, including its earlier versions. The record keeps who erased what and why, not the content.
admin.eraseReasonHint: Kept in the record, so write it for the people who read it later.
admin.eraseCleanedHint: The document restarts with this text and loses its earlier history.
admin.erasePrompt: Erase it for good? This cannot be undone.
files.pairNoComments: Comments are written on a revision, a commit or a range of commits. Switch to one of those to comment.
